tagline.en_US: Run a single-node rqlite database with a persistent SQLite-compatible SQL API. The same instance can later be expanded into a cluster manually.

description.en_US: rqlite is a lightweight, fault-tolerant, distributed relational database built on SQLite. It provides full SQL support and replicates data across nodes to ensure high availability and reliability. Applications can interact with it using an easy-to-use HTTP API, a command-line interface, or a built-in console application.
